Lampen, die in 3D genau so leuchten wie: Lamps that glow in 3D exactly like yours at home, sensors with their values, and cameras with their field of view.
Wie deine Geräte aus Home Assistant in d: In this episode I'll show you how your devices from Home Assistant get into the plan.
Folge 6 hat zwei Teile. In Teil 1 geht e: Episode 6 comes in two parts. Part 1 is about a room's device list, placing devices, symbols and names.
Teil 2 zeigt Lampen und Kameras im Detai: Part 2 covers lamps and cameras in detail. All you need are rooms linked to an area in Home Assistant – that was episode 1.
Ich tippe im Editor das Wohnzimmer an. R: In the editor I tap the living room. On the right, under Devices – in German „Geräte“ – you see everything that sits in the living room area in Home Assistant.
Die Liste ist nach Geräten sortiert: vor: The list is grouped by device: the main entity comes first, the rest is tucked in behind it.
Die Pixeluhr hat zum Beispiel vier weite: The pixel clock, for example, has four more lights for indicators and effects. “+4 more” – „+4 weitere“ – unfolds them, “less” – „weniger“ – folds them away again.
Sensoren erscheinen, wenn sie etwas für: Sensors show up when they measure something for the room: temperature, humidity, CO2, power and energy, gas and water, brightness and air pressure.
Akku- und Signalsensoren bleiben weg. Un: Battery and signal sensors are left out. And if a device is missing, it's usually assigned to a different area in Home Assistant.
For large areas, the search field helps.
Über der Liste wählst du die Quelle. „Di: Above the list you pick the source. “This area” – „Dieser Bereich“ – is the default, and the number tells you how many devices it has.
„Andere Bereiche“ zeigt die Geräte aller: “Other areas” – „Andere Bereiche“ – shows the devices of all the other areas, sorted by area. If one is already placed in another room, it says so.
„Platzieren“ holt es dann hierher. Der B: “Place” – „Platzieren“ – then brings it over here. Its area in Home Assistant stays as it is.
„Ohne Bereich“ zeigt alles, was keinem B: “No area” – „Ohne Bereich“ – shows everything that isn't assigned to an area: template lights, groups and helpers. Here every sensor with a number and a unit counts.
Werden es zu viele, sagt die Liste, wie: If there are too many, the list tells you how many more there are – then you narrow it down with the search.
Zurück zu „Dieser Bereich“. Helle Einträ: Back to “This area”. Bright entries are already in the plan, faded ones are not yet.
„Platzieren“ setzt ein Gerät in den Raum: “Place” puts a device into the room. The temperature sensor now sits in the plan as a symbol.
Ich ziehe ihn an seinen Platz – an die W: I drag it to its spot – onto the wall next to the kitchen.
„Alle 5 platzieren …“ setzt nach einer R: “Place all 5 …” – „Alle 5 platzieren …“ – asks once and then places all the remaining main devices in one go.
Lichter werden dabei gleich als Leuchte: Lights are placed straight away as a lamp from the library, so they glow in 3D – like the pixel clock here. More on that in part 2.
Gefällt dir das nicht, nimmt „Rückgängig: If you don't like it, “Undo” – „Rückgängig“ – or Ctrl+Z takes them all back in one step.
Ein platziertes Gerät nimmst du mit „Ent: To take a placed device out again, use “Remove” – „Entfernen“ – in its row.
Die kleinen Knöpfe in jeder Zeile gehöre: The small buttons in each row belong to the room panel in 3D. It shows the devices placed in the room.
Der Stern nimmt ein Gerät zusätzlich auf: The star adds a device to it without placing it – here the humidity.
Das Auge blendet ein Gerät im Raumfenste: The eye hides a device from the room panel. It gets crossed out, and a second tap brings it back.
„Aa“ blendet nur den Zustand aus – prakt: “Aa” only hides the state – handy for a blind that doesn't report its position.
In 3D steht die Luftfeuchtigkeit jetzt i: In 3D, the humidity now shows up in the room panel, the TV is gone, and the blind comes without a percentage.
Ganz unten blendet „Weitere Geräte des B: At the very bottom, “More devices in this area” – „Weitere Geräte des Bereichs“ – shows the rest; hidden ones stay away.
Zurück im Editor: Unter „Raumklima“ legs: Back in the editor: under “Room climate” – „Raumklima“ – you choose which sensors provide the room's temperature, humidity and CO2 – for the heatmap and the room panel.
„Automatisch“ nimmt die Sensoren des Ber: “Automatic” takes the area's sensors and the ones placed in the room – but no device temperatures, say from a 3D printer. You can also pick a sensor, or “None”.
Tippst du ein Gerät im Plan an, öffnet s: Tap a device in the plan and its form opens on the right. At the top you see its type and name, and next to it “Lock” – „Fixieren“ – against moving it by accident.
„X“ und „Y“ setzen den Platz genau. „Höh: X and Y set the position exactly. “Symbol height” – „Höhe des Symbols“ – sets how high the pin floats in 3D, and “Automatic height” – „Höhe automatisch“ – resets it.
„Drehung“ dreht das Gerät – wichtig vor: “Rotation” – „Drehung“ – turns the device. That matters most for cameras – more on that in part 2.
„In Raummitte“ holt ein verrutschtes Ger: “To room centre” – „In Raummitte“ – brings a stray device back to the middle, and “Remove” takes it out of the plan.
Bei Schaltern und Lampen gibt es „Vor de: Switches and lamps have “Ask before switching” – „Vor dem Schalten nachfragen“. I'll take the coffee machine in the kitchen.
Mit Haken fragt NeonPlan erst nach – bei: With the tick set, NeonPlan asks first – when you tap it in 3D, in the quick menu and in the room panel. That protects, say, the server switch from an accidental tap.
Ein Doppeltipp auf den Raum, der alle Li: A double tap on the room, which switches all the lights, leaves such a device out. And swiping doesn't move it either.
Hat ein Gerät in Home Assistant einen Le: If a device has a power sensor in Home Assistant, its symbol in 3D shows the watts – right now the coffee machine draws 900 watts.
„Symbol in 3D“ legt fest, wann der Pin e: “Symbol in 3D” – „Symbol in 3D“ – decides when the pin appears. “Automatic” follows the switch in the 3D view, “Always show” – „Immer zeigen“ – always shows it.
„Ohne Watt“ lässt die Leistung weg, etwa: “Without watts” – „Ohne Watt“ – leaves out the power, for a smart plug for example. “Hide” – „Ausblenden“ – never shows a symbol.
Mit Energie Pro gibt es außerdem ein Hol: With Energy Pro you also get a hologram above the device: power right now, today's consumption and the day's curve.
„Eigenes Symbol“ ersetzt das Symbol nach: “Own symbol” – „Eigenes Symbol“ – replaces the symbol for the device type. You enter the name of a Material Design icon, just like in Home Assistant.
Daneben erscheint gleich die Vorschau. L: A preview appears right next to it. Leave it empty for the standard symbol.
„Eigener Name“ gilt nur im Plan – die En: “Own name” – „Eigener Name“ – only applies in the plan; the entity in Home Assistant stays as it is.
Dann erscheint „Name unter dem Symbol in: Then “Show name below the symbol in 3D” appears – „Name unter dem Symbol in 3D zeigen“. That way, say, three thermometers in the garden stay easy to tell apart.
Für die Dashboard-Karte gibt es dafür au: The dashboard card also has an option that shows all own names – more in the episode about the card.
In 3D steht der Pin jetzt mit Kaffeetass: In 3D, the pin now shows a coffee cup, the watts and the name.
Oben rechts wählst du, welche Symbole di: Top right, you choose which symbols the 3D view shows: “None”, “Important” or “All” – „Keine“, „Wichtige“, „Alle“.
„Wichtige“ lässt Lampen und Geräte weg,: “Important” leaves out lamps and devices that their 3D model already shows; sensors and watts stay. “None” hides them all – even the ones set to “Always show”.
Tippe ich die Kaffeemaschine an, kommt j: When I tap the coffee machine now, the question comes first. Only “OK” switches it.
Lange drücken öffnet bei Schaltern und L: A long press opens the quick menu for switches and lamps. Part 2 shows how to control lamps in 3D.
Manche Geräte sehen als Möbel besser aus: Some devices look better as furniture. The heating in the living room is still a plain pin.
„Als Möbel darstellen“ ersetzt den Pin d: “Show as furniture” – „Als Möbel darstellen“ – replaces the pin with a matching item in the same spot, already linked to the device. The list only shows what fits the device type.
Aus der Heizung ist ein Heizkörper gewor: The heating has become a radiator that glows in 3D while it's heating. A speaker, a lamp or the robot vacuum work the same way.
Im Möbelformular holt „Wieder als Geräte: In the furniture form, “Back to a device pin” – „Wieder als Geräte-Pin“ – brings back the plain pin, and Ctrl+Z undoes either.
Kurz zusammengefasst: Die Geräteliste ze: To sum up: the device list shows the room's area, “Place” puts devices into the plan, and in the form you set the symbol, the name and the question before switching.
Part 2 is about lamps and cameras.
